title: CAMOS: Coupled Oscillatory State-Space Model for Multimodal Clinical Time-Series
abstract: arXiv:2609.39484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal clinical cohorts are multimodal, irregularly sampled and pervasively incomplete: in ADNI, positron emission tomography and cerebrospinal fluid assays are absent from roughly half of all visits. Linear state-space models handle irregular sampling gracefully but treat a missing modality by masking the input, leaving the transition operator untouched. We prove that this is a representational limitation: the latent state of any linear state-space layer whose transition operator does not depend on the availability pattern is an additive function of the availability indicators, so no such layer can represent an interaction between two modalities being jointly present or jointly absent. translated_title: CAMOS：面向多模态临床时间序列的耦合振荡状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 纵向临床队列具有多模态、非规则采样且普遍不完整的特点：在ADNI数据集中，正电子发射断层扫描（PET）和脑脊液检测在大约一半的访视中缺失。线性状态空间模型能够优雅地处理非规则采样，但其通过掩码输入来处理缺失模态，而转移算子保持不变。我们证明这是一种表征能力上的局限：对于任何转移算子不依赖于可用性模式的线性状态空间层，其潜在状态都是可用性指示的加性函数，因此这类层无法表示两种模态同时存在或同时缺失之间的交互作用。我们提出CAMOS，为每个模态配备一组二阶振荡器，通过一个位于微分方程内部并由可用性门控的矩阵实现耦合，从而使转移算子本身成为哪些测量可用的函数。
tldr: 本文证明了线性状态空间模型用掩码处理缺失模态存在表征局限——无法建模模态联合存在或缺失的交互作用，并提出CAMOS模型，通过可用性门控的耦合二阶振荡器使转移算子本身随模态可用性变化，从而更好地建模多模态临床时间序列。
en_tdlr: CAMOS reveals a representational limitation of masking-based missing-modality handling in linear state-space models, and addresses it by coupling modality-specific second-order oscillators through an availability-gated matrix inside the differential equation, making the transition operator itself a function of which modalities are present.
